sourceSentences: [0] Be careful of being harassed by Lulu. Apply pressure from early game to gain lane control,
[0] and engage whenever the enemy steps within range.
[1] Lulu is an immobile support with a good poke, but isn't too much of a threat to you
[1] Polymorph and Wild Growth can instantly deny your all-in and save her ADC.
[2] You can try to poke him down, Buffer poly when you think he's going to jump, it will cancel the stun.
[2] Play very safe and wait for him to use his empowered Q on you, then you can step a bit closer
